string.text: The generator is repaired. It needs an electric artefact to run.
The generator is running: the shelter has light.
The tool kit Kardan lent to repair the generator in the shelter.
A crumpled notebook page in hurried handwriting.

Whoever finds this, read it.

We found a proper bunker: thick walls, room for the whole group. But there's work up to our necks: rubble to clear, the corridors to look through.

We ordered a laptop from Sidorovich and paid in advance: someone has to go and fetch it. I keep its flash drive on me: the map of the rooms, the wiring and the rest. Without it we're blind kittens here.

Nothing to give us light: there's a generator, but it's dead. Lom went to Kardan at Yanov: he has the right tool kit and promised to lend it for old times' sake.

We'll sit tight a couple of days. My head has been splitting for two days now, and the dreams... Must be just tired.
Kardan's spare card: opens the way into the test centre by the Iron Forest on Zaton.
A sealed case from professor Sakharov for Sidorovich: artefact samples in shielded cells.
A laptop with a flash drive: the map of the bunker's rooms and its wiring. Runs on mains power only.
The PDA of a stalker called Lom. The last entry: "The test centre. Kardan wasn't lying..."
The laptop is set on the desk.
No power: the generator isn't running.
Clear the heaps of earth and rubble, carry the bodies out of the rooms you can get to. Takes about a day.
The rooms you can get to are clean already.
It's a lot of work: eat and drink first.
The cleaning took a day. The shelter is clean.
A group of stalkers ordered a laptop from you. The ones who settled in the bunker.
That they did. Ordered it, paid up, and nobody came to collect. I thought somebody did them in.
Worse. They're zombified, wandering around their bunker.

Damn... Shame about the lads, good customers: paid up front, never haggled. Fine, the laptop's yours, but not for a thank-you. Sakharov owes me a container of artefacts, and my legs aren't government issue. Go to Yantar, bring it here, and you get the laptop.
I see, I see. Back aching? That's no bottle of vodka. Here's your laptop. And mind: I'm not in the business of charging it. Find your own power, a generator or an anomaly.
Professor, Sidorovich sent me. He says you have a container for him.

Ah, the container... Yes, yes, samples for our mutual acquaintance. A warning, young man: the case is a heavy one and its cells are shielded. Don't even think of opening it: the samples are, shall we say, temperamental.
Kardan, did a stalker come by? From the group that settled in the bunker. For tools for a generator.

Lom? He did... I gave him the tools, good ones, from the old days. Then we sat down and had a drink, as you do. And drunk as I was I ran my mouth: the test centre on Zaton I worked in, "Item 62"... He lit up. Said he'd go have a peek. Drunk, at nightfall.

Nothing. Not a word since. That centre is by the Iron Forest, the way down is by the crashed helicopter. He talked me out of my access card, but I kept a spare: here. If he went in there, it's bad. I'd like to know what became of him... I'm not one to go there anymore.
I'll see what happened to him.
I found Lom. In the test centre, dead. Here's his PDA.
Ah... It was me who sent him there, with my tongue. Thanks for bringing it, at least now I know. Here, take this "Flash". It's no use to me, and you'll need it to start your generator.
The bunker group's flash drive: the map of the rooms, the wiring and the rest. The laptop needs it.
It needs the flash drive: without it the laptop has neither the map of the rooms nor the wiring.
The flash drive is in the laptop.
The flash drive is in. No power: the generator isn't running.
Ask Sidorovich about the laptop the group ordered.
Get the artefact container for Sidorovich from professor Sakharov at Yantar.
Set the laptop on the desk in the small room by the passage.
Put the flash drive into the laptop.
Ask Kardan at Yanov about the tools.
Find Lom: he went to the test centre by the Iron Forest on Zaton. The way down is by the crashed helicopter; Kardan's card opens the door.
Repair the generator with Kardan's tools.
Start the generator: put an electric artefact into it.
Clear the rubble with a shovel (%d%%)
The shovel broke. Clearing the rubble: %d%%
The rubble is cleared, the way is open
Arrows: category | Wheel: choose | LMB: place | RMB on furniture: into the stash | H: leave
An old iron barrel from the bunker. Can be placed in the shelter.
A plain wooden chair from the bunker. Can be placed in the shelter.
A battered wooden table from the bunker. Can be placed in the shelter.
A wooden crate from the bunker. Can be placed in the shelter.
A rusty metal rack from the bunker. Can be placed in the shelter.
Old boards from the bunker. Can be laid in the shelter.
A wooden pallet from the bunker. Can be laid in the shelter.
A white door off its hinges. Can be placed in the shelter.

The Nosorog exoskeleton of a mercenary everyone called the Brigadier. A professional who looked after his gear: the suit is upgraded to the limit, all five artefact containers are open and shielded, so no artefact radiation gets through and no applied modules are needed. Lightened to 18 kg. Its patches are torn off: in it you pass for a loner.\n\nA module built into the helmet: a light (L), Oracle night vision (N), thermal vision (hold N) and an anomaly visor (J). It runs on the suit's accumulator: drag a battery onto the suit. With an electric artefact on the belt it runs on that, which also charges the accumulator and the PDA in its slot.
Built into the Brigadier's Nosorog helmet: a light (L), Oracle night vision (N), thermal vision (hold N) and an anomaly visor (J). It can't be taken out; its charge is the suit's accumulator.

The M4 Tactical carbine the Brigadier carried. Upgraded to the limit and well kept: it wears down from firing half as fast as an upgraded ordinary one, and the Chemist made it a quarter lighter. Any fitting scope goes onto its Picatinny rail; the Surefire silencer comes off.
The shelter is a group's: form a group with your friends, then the note gives the tasks.
The Chemist's idea is noted, but in co-op the shelter's tasks go to a group only: make a group with your friends and open the idea again.
A PDA with a broken screen. It won't switch on, but its memory seems intact. In theory its data could be unloaded into your own.
Nowhere to unload it: your own PDA must be in its slot.
Unloading the data into your PDA... %s%%
Data unloaded: your PDA has a Base tab now.

The SEVA scientific suit the Chemist reworked for himself: plates of an alloy baked with Vyvert dust make it a third lighter than an ordinary one, and it is upgraded to the limit. Its patches are torn off: in it you pass for a loner.

The .45 ACP Kriss Vector the Chemist carried. Upgraded to the limit, it wears down half as fast as an upgraded ordinary one and is a quarter lighter. A silencer and a red dot; another sight fits its Picatinny rail too. The Chemist loaded it with expansive Hydra-Shok.
Talk to Professor Herman in the scientists' bunker on Jupiter about the capsules for anomalous matter.
Fill the capsules in anomalies: %s of %s. Only in an SSP from Topaz up or in the Chemist's SEVA.
Take Professor Herman a capsule of each nature.
Put the capsules into the synthesis chambers by the shelter's entrance: %d of %d.

Professor Herman's experimental trap capsule, empty. Put into an anomaly of the nature it is marked for, it takes in its matter in about a minute; the anomaly burns out till the next emission. Only in an SSP from Topaz up or in the Chemist's SEVA: in another suit the capsule kills as it closes.
Fill the capsules for a gravitational anomaly: %s of %s.
Fill the capsules for a thermal anomaly: %s of %s.
Fill the capsules for a chemical anomaly: %s of %s.
Fill the capsules for an electrical anomaly: %s of %s.
No anomaly near enough: come closer, within 4 m.
This anomaly is of another nature: the capsule isn't for it.
The capsule is in the anomaly: about a minute, and the matter is inside.
The capsule is filled. The anomaly has burnt out till the next emission.
Professor Herman's capsule, filled with anomalous matter. Take it in hand only in an SSP from Topaz up or in the Chemist's SEVA: in another suit its discharge kills on the spot.
%s: needs a capsule of its matter
It needs a filled capsule of its nature.
The capsule is in. %s is ready.
The synthesis chambers are ready. Recipes next.
All that's left of a failed synthesis: a fused lump in which nothing put in can be told any more. Scientists take them for pennies, for their statistics.
A stone came out. Resonance: %d of %d.
The chamber is still being tuned. Try again in a few seconds.
What can go in (junk, mutant parts, artefacts):
Nothing in the backpack can go into the chamber.
The load: two or three things
Click a thing to put it into the load, click a slot of the load to take it back.
This load has not been tried in this chamber yet.
Tried before: a stone, resonance %d of %d.
The journal is empty: load a chamber at its panel.
No recipes yet: the Chemist's recipes and every load that made an artefact will be here.
Click a room on the plan.
A store once the rubble is dug out.
No store: make a room the store in the Shelter plan.
The panel is broken. It takes:
The control box is broken. It takes:
The control box is repaired: the lift down works
The lift's control box: no power
State: no way in, the lift is broken
A rusty ventilation duct from the bunker. It can stand anywhere.
Skryaga is under pressure: no supply from him, drink fetches far more.
The Scorcher gave a harmonic: medicine is swept off the shelves at higher prices.
Fewer guests while the general markup is above x1.10.
Part of the food in the store is spoiled.
Dry law at the Warehouses: no supply from Skryaga, drink is dear.
A psi surge: demand for medicine is up.
Sidorovich sent a cheap caravan: fewer guests till the markup goes down.
Rats in the store: part of the food is spoiled.
The courier is silent: %s, %s. The cargo is marked on the map for %s h, then it is looted.
The cargo is recovered and in the store's books: %s, %s.
A contract handed in: %s, %s RU in the till.
A case with a lot for the shelter. Once you have it, the lot is in the store's books.
Empty: put goods into the store room's boxes or buy a lot.
The supplier is dead: no orders.
You are not welcome: no orders.
Pick a lot: always under retail, the larger the cheaper.
On the way, up to %d h
Intercepted! On the map, %d h more
No contracts now, new ones come twice a day.
No orders box assigned: orders are handed in through it.
Which box takes the orders? Put all that's for orders in it; it isn't part of the store.
There's no box in the shelter.
Trade has stopped: no visitors, no new orders.
Бункер Сахарова закрыт на проверку, его поставки заморожены. Медицина в цене.
Бункер Сахарова закрыт на проверку: его поставки заморожены.
Сталкеры в панике забивают бар и сметают медицину, еду и патроны по любым ценам.
Два выброса подряд: толпы сталкеров идут к нам.
Снайперы Монолита на подступах к Радару. Поставщики не берут заказы, пока их не перебьют.
Монолитовцы сели на скалах Радара: поставки встали.
The artefact in the generator has burnt out.
Шуруп приедет на базу к следующему вашему заходу.
Периметр укреплён: караваны больше не перехватываются.
Сводный отряд погиб: караваны снова под угрозой.
Баюн вырос: вредители на складе больше не страшны.
Нужны учёные: спасти их в рейде.
Врача нет: спасти его в рейде.
Нет свободной камеры или подходящих вещей при себе.
Чинит стволы на складе, расходует ремкомплекты из записи.
Перемирие и сводный отряд с пси-шлемами на развилке.
Shurup put a new artefact into the generator.
The container by the generator: he swaps the artefact when the charge falls.
The autoclave is done: %s is lighter and stronger.
Your head is splitting! Turn back!
Your head is splitting, you can't bear to go further.
Your head is splitting, you can't bear to go further. You came too far just to turn back. Find a safer place to rest and think. What is along this road?
You should have thought of safety earlier. Now just act.
The way on leads straight into the Scorcher's white zone. Death there even in a helmet: go round.
A coded door. It won't open without a decoder.
The decoder is working out the code. Stay close.
The decoder has started. The Monolith will notice.
The code is found. X-10's door is open.
Shurup and the scientists built the decoder.
A PDA modified like the Chemist's, with spare boards. It works out X-10's door code while you stay close.
Code lock: the door won't open
The shelter is a group's business: only a group can get in.
Shelter "Radar-1": the way in at the end of the tunnel
I'll see to them. I need: %s. Got it?
Done. They'll be on their feet in a couple of hours.
Shov has seen to the wounded: the men are fit again.
Sure. Show me what you've got.
%s: he can't wear that, take it back.
There's a job. The shelter's entrance needs guarding.
We owe you. Where do we stand?
Up top, at the gate. Hold a post there.
Yes, sir. Moving out. Shov stays here.
The assault group now guards the shelter's entrance.
